description: Header file defining WebSocket link types and server types with classes for handling WebSocket connections, including upgrade, message serialization/deserialization, and state management within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: HWebSocketLinkType
classes.description: Template class managing WebSocket links with nested handler classes for connection, message serialization/deserialization, and upgrade handling.

classes.name: HWebSocketServerType
classes.description: Template class representing a WebSocket server with nested handler class for managing WebSocket connections.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns reference to the underlying link object.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Const version, returns reference to the underlying link object.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier string.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier string.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the connection is open.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the connection is suspended.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the connection is closed.

methods.name: IsWebServer
methods.description: Checks if the link is a web server.

methods.name: IsUpgrading
methods.description: Checks if the link is in upgrading state.

methods.name: IsWebSocket
methods.description: Checks if the link is a WebSocket.

methods.name: IsCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the connection process is complete.

methods.name: Binary
methods.description: Sets or gets binary mode.

methods.name: Masking
methods.description: Sets or gets masking mode.

methods.name: ResetActivity
methods.description: Resets activity indicator.

methods.name: HasActivity
methods.description: Checks if there is activity.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Returns the request path.

methods.name: Query
methods.description: Returns the query string.

methods.name: Protocols
methods.description: Returns the protocols array.

methods.name: Protocols
methods.description: Sets the protocols array.

methods.name: Upgrade
methods.description: Initiates WebSocket upgrade with protocol, path, query, and origin.

methods.name: AbortUpgrade
methods.description: Aborts the upgrade with status and reason.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the connection with a wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the connection with a wait time.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the link.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes message buffers.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits an outbound message.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Abstract method to process inbound link body.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Abstract method to process inbound messages.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Abstract method to send outbound messages.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Abstract method to process received data.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Abstract method to send data.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Abstract method to handle state changes.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Abstract method to check if link is idle.
